import sqlite3,pathlib,json,datetime,hashlib,os
root=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack')
p=root/'.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite'
out={'db_present':p.is_file()}
if p.is_file():
 db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(p)+'?mode=ro',uri=True,timeout=4)
 db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
 try:
  rows=db.execute("""SELECT d.id,d.sim_slot,d.status,d.last_seen_at,d.created_at,
  a.status account_status,s.status site_status,ag.status agent_status
  FROM device_bindings d LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=d.account_id
  LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id=d.site_id LEFT JOIN agents ag ON ag.id=d.agent_id
  ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 25""").fetchall()
  out['bindings']=[dict(r) for r in rows]
  out['counts']=[dict(r) for r in db.execute('SELECT sim_slot,status,COUNT(*) count FROM device_bindings GROUP BY sim_slot,status')]
  out['platform_live_profiles']=db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM integrations WHERE provider='google_live' AND status='active'").fetchone()[0]
 except Exception as ex: out['database_error']=type(ex).__name__+': '+str(ex)[:90]
 finally: db.close()
v=root/'public_html/saas/console/_core/DevicePairing.php'
out['device_endpoint_php_present']=(root/'public_html/saas/console/device/v1/index.php').is_file()
out['device_pairing_file_digest']=hashlib.sha256(v.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16] if v.is_file() else None
out['utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
